note: The only list of versions the kit trusts. install/install.ps1, install/install.sh and `fk setup` install exactly these; tests/setup.test.mjs fails when a script drifts from this file. min = below this is red; version = the tested pin (older but >= min is yellow, newer is kept). exact = both install scripts install exactly this version (or commit); git, git-lfs, node, podman and mise come from the OS package manager (winget pins the version; brew/apt/dnf give their current release), checked against min; just (and gh outside Windows and Homebrew) come pinned through mise.

git.source: winget Git.Git | xcode-select / brew | apt / dnf

git-lfs.source: winget GitHub.GitLFS (also bundled with Git for Windows) | brew git-lfs | apt / dnf / pacman git-lfs

mise.source: winget jdx.mise | https://mise.run with MISE_VERSION=v<version> | brew mise
mise.activation: agents use mise exec / mise x; the founder may add mise activate to the shell profile

just.source: mise use -g just@<version> (after the mise step when mise is installed in the same run) | winget Casey.Just / brew / apt only when mise cannot be installed

podman.source: winget RedHat.Podman (needs WSL2) | brew podman | apt / dnf / pacman podman (apt below the floor: a founder note, never re-planned; Ubuntu 24.04+ / Debian 13+ or podman.io packages)
podman.note: An existing Docker counts: Podman is never added next to a working Docker. Windows and macOS run containers in a small Linux machine (podman machine).

podman-compose.source: uv tool install podman-compose==<version> (only when neither Docker nor docker-compose is present); Windows: winget Docker.DockerCompose (podman compose prefers docker-compose; Podman Desktop sets up the same binary)

gh.source: winget GitHub.cli | brew gh | mise use -g gh@<version> elsewhere (apt ships gh below the floor, e.g. 2.4.0 on Ubuntu 22.04)
gh.auth: founder action: gh auth login (never run for them)
